import sys
import re

insideBraceWordCount = 0
maxWordLen = 0

def countWordsInString(s):
    s = s.replace("_", " ")
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(r" +", " ", s)
    tokens = s.split(" ")
    if len(tokens) == 1 and tokens[0] == "":
        return 0
    return len(tokens)

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    totalInputs = int(input_data[0])
    inputStr = input_data[1]
    bracePositions = [-1]
    for i, ch in enumerate(inputStr):
        if ch == '(' or ch == ')':
            bracePositions.append(i)
    index = 1
    totalWords = 0
    maxWordLength = 0
    outsideContent = ""
    while index < len(bracePositions) - 1:
        start = bracePositions[index]
        end = bracePositions[index + 1]
        insideBrace = inputStr[start + 1:end]
        countWords = countWordsInString(insideBrace)
        global insideBraceWordCount
        insideBraceWordCount += countWords
        prev_end = bracePositions[index - 1]
        outsideContent += "_" + inputStr[prev_end + 1:start]
        index += 2
    outsideContent += "_" + inputStr[bracePositions[-1] + 1:]
    outsideContent = outsideContent.replace("_", " ")
    outsideContent = outsideContent.strip()
    outsideContent = re.sub(r" +", " ", outsideContent)
    outsideWords = outsideContent.split(" ")
    for w in outsideWords:
        if len(w) > maxWordLen:
            maxWordLen = len(w)
    print(f"{maxWordLen} {insideBraceWordCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
